public_data_design.teacher_records: 137 anonymous teacher records numbered P001 through P137 with rating variables only.
public_data_design.practitioner_referenced_cohort: 75 distinct teachers identified by complete six-dimension practitioner-FBA similarity ratings.
public_data_design.matched_comparison_cohort: 62 teachers identified by complete six-dimension general-purpose-AI similarity ratings.
public_data_design.expert_records: Four anonymous expert records across two paired rounds plus arithmetic-average final scores.
public_data_design.privacy_fields_removed: Collection mode, original identifiers, names, teaching stage, reported grade, and other source metadata are absent from the public files.
public_data_design.source_reconciliation_correction: One overall general-purpose-AI similarity response was corrected from 4 to 3 before public release after comparison with the source response label.

methods.ordinal_descriptives: Complete recorded-value distribution, median (IQR), P(rating >= 4), Wilson 95% CI; decimal expert overall ratings are preserved
methods.multiple_testing: Holm adjustment within each six-test or seven-correlation family
methods.expert_round_rule: Final expert scores equal the arithmetic mean of paired Round 1 and Round 2 ratings.
methods.comparison_measure_interpretation: The practitioner-referenced similarity evaluation and matched general-purpose AI comparison use perceived-similarity ratings; concurrent and discriminant validity require dedicated future designs.

scope_note: The analyses estimate teacher-perception and expert-rating quantities; diagnostic accuracy, student outcomes, professional equivalence, and autonomous decision making are separate evaluation targets.
